item.title: Europe's wildfires are igniting forgotten WWII and Cold War bombs
item.description: Europe is full of buried explosives left over from 20th century wars, and the continent’s wildfires are now big enough, hot enough and last long enough to reach them

item.title: How spaceflight changes astronauts' ability to eat and drink
item.description: If humans are to spend more time in space, scientists need to understand how life in microgravity affects eating and drinking
